notes: Sourced from Yamaha USA's official AG06MK2 specs page and the official AG06MK2 User Guide PDF (usa.yamaha.com/files/download/other_assets/2/1549762/AG06mk2_user_guide_En_C0.pdf). This is a desktop unit (not rack-mountable). Ch1 and Ch2 are combo XLR/TRS mic-line inputs sharing one +48V phantom switch; Ch2 additionally has a HI-Z/guitar mode on the same jack. Ch3/4 (phone) and Ch5/6 (RCA) are stereo line inputs. STEREO OUT (fixed mix, phone jacks) is distinct from MONITOR OUT (level-controlled by the Speaker knob, also phone jacks) — the AG03MK2 variant instead uses RCA monitor-out jacks, but AG06MK2 uses phone/TRS for both. The rear panel has two separate USB-C jacks: one carries USB Audio Class 2.0 data plus bus power to/from the host ("USB 2.0" jack, explicitly named and shipped with a USB 2.0 cable, hence grade usb-2.0), and a second power-only USB-C jack for an external 5V/1A adapter or battery when the host can't supply enough bus power (no data, so no USB grade assigned). No SDI/HDMI/DisplayPort/Ethernet ports exist on this device. Confidence is high because all connector names and types come directly from Yamaha's own manual/spec page rather than inference.

ports.name: Mic/Line 1
ports.note: Combo jack; XLR (balanced, +48V phantom via CH1-2MIC switch) or phone (balanced/unbalanced)

ports.name: Mic/Line/Guitar 2
ports.note: Combo jack; XLR (+48V phantom) or phone; GUITAR/HI-Z switch for direct instrument input

ports.name: Ch 3/4 L (Mono)
ports.note: Stereo line input, phone jack; mono source here feeds both L/R

ports.name: Stereo Out L
ports.note: Fixed mixed stereo out, unaffected by monitor/streaming-out settings

ports.name: Monitor Out L
ports.note: Powered-monitor output, level set by Speaker knob

ports.name: Foot SW
ports.note: For optional Yamaha FC5 footswitch, mutes reverb

ports.name: Headset Mic
ports.note: Pink 3.5mm mic input, feeds Ch1; mutually exclusive with Ch1 mic/line jack

ports.name: Headset Phones
ports.note: Light-green 3.5mm output, mirrors main Phones jack

ports.name: USB 2.0 (to PC/iPhone)
ports.note: USB Audio Class 2.0, 24-bit/192kHz, 2in/2out; carries bus power from a computer; ships with USB-C to USB-A 2.0 cable

ports.name: 5V DC IN (USB)
ports.note: Power-only USB-C input for a USB adapter/battery (4.8-5.2V, min 1A) when connected to an iPhone/iPad or a non-powering computer port
